comment.comment:
WHAT IT IS
Co-Noir combines two things:
Multiparty computation (MPC): an order is split into secret shares across several independent nodes. No single node ever holds the full order.

Zero-knowledge proofs: those nodes compute together on the shares and jointly produce a Noir proof that the result is correct.
Private and verifiable at the same time. Computation no one can see, with a proof everyone can check.

WHY IT FITS TARTAGLIA
Our settlement already runs on Noir and UltraHonk. Co-Noir extends the exact same stack into MPC, adapting the UltraHonk prover for collaborative proving.

WHAT TARTAGLIA WILL BE ABLE TO DO
Blind matching: orders crossed by a network of independent nodes, none of which can read side, size or limit
